title: ticfac settle: the printed command fails for a cloud attempt, and a --release value with spaces is refused
description: 2026-10-08, settling ex6's held cloud attempts: (1) the hold message prints 'ticfac settle ex6 <tick> <n> --run-id … --release "<who>" --carry-work', which refuses a cloud attempt ('ran on executor cloudflare-sandbox, and no profile set this build carries resolves one naming it') unless --profiles=profiles-cloudflare-sandbox is added; settle should resolve the executor from the attempt record. (2) --release "two words" fails with 'exactly one epic id, tick id and attempt number are required' — a flag value containing spaces is split into positionals; --release=operator works. Also: the release is a person's step the mandate wants gone — a held attempt whose cause is fixed on main should be re-dispatchable by the run (kk7-style) without settle.
acceptance_criteria: the printed settle command works verbatim for a cloud attempt; --release values with spaces parse; tests; make gate
